prompt_text: Many cities are now turning parks and farmland into new housing developments. Is this a positive or negative development?
essay_text:
In the contemporary days a lot of cities experiencing dramatic growth. And that’s why authorities struggled with lack of residential land where builders can construct fresh accommodation. Government decided, that the easier way to eliminate this issue is using park land for building residential apartments.

It is agreed that transforming park land is definitely unpleasant development leading to negative consequences. This essay outline major drawbacks of turning parks into residential area. 

Firstly ,it should be mentioned that it is well known fact, that parks which are planted with various flora, can produce oxygen and maintain the air quality. That’s why massive decreasing of planted parks can lead to loosing natural tool to filter pollution. Recent news showed that Jakarta, the capital city of Indonesia become the most polluted city in the world. The city development is raising rapidly, government was concentrate on providing accommodation for local population, and forgot about environment improvement. It was admitted , that  was the biggest mistake done by Indonesian’s authority leading to massive air pollution. As a result, city become so contaminated that people started get diseases invoked by pollutants.

Secondly,it is obvious that such action as replacement farmland into housing area can case sudden raising of product’s prices due to transition to imported products. An excellent example of such strategy is city Mumbai ,again,in India. Mumbai is known as expensive city, due to fact that all eatable products are costly in the town. High prices explained by the fact that government have to import all products from downtown. So,It is clearly seen that replacement farmlands it is a bad strategy for development cities. 

To summarise , transforming parks and farmlands into housing area will invoke environmental and economic issue for population. Therefore , people deny such developments assuring that protecting nature and sustaining moderate prices more important for them. After thorough analysis on this subject, it is predicted that government will consider this issue more deeper and provides various ways of solution.

prompt_text: Many governments think that economic progress is their most important goal. Some people, however, think that other types of progress are equally important for a country. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay_text:
People have different views on how progress should be measured in their countries. Economic progress is believed by a growing number of people to be the most fundamental goal which should be achieved, while I agree with those who think that authorities should place equal importance on other kinds of progress as well.

On the one hand, economic growth is a key consideration when judging improvement in countries. Such growth is vital for countries as it can provide people with more job opportunities which can result in alleviate poverty. In other words, as governments attain more economical goals, the sources of funds would increase and people who are in charge would be able to creat more jobs with higher salaries. As a result, as people would earn more money,the rate of poverty would increase and more people would enjoy welfare. Therefore, placing a premium on making progress in monetory firlds is of benefit for citizens.

On the other hand, there are other types of progress ,such as environmental and mental ones, which should be made by governments because they are as crucial as econoic growth. Making progress in the environmental fields is vitally important for countries. Enhancing countries’ environmental status by accomplishing eco-friendly goals ,such as planting more trees and minimizing the amount of air pollution, can result in survival of our next generation and preservation of the earth. In addition ,making progress in people’s mental well-being is considered to be so important because unless people are mentally healthy, the other kinds of progress will unable to be achieved and also people will not have a sense of satisfaction in their lives. 

In conclusion, even though the significance of economic progress is undeniable, governments should make progress in environment and citizens’ mental health.

prompt_text: Climate change is a phenomenon that affects countries all over the world. Many people strongly believe that it is the responsibility of individuals, rather than corporations and governments, to deal with this problem. To what extent do you agree?
essay_text:
In this day and age, climate change has had adverse ramifications on nations globally. Several people do have the perception that  the onus is on individuals to find a solution to this menace instead of companies and governments. Although individuals to some extent have a role to play in mitigating the effect of climate change, I vehemently disagree with the view that individuals have a major part to play in it. This essay will discuss why it is the companies and governments that should bear the greatest responsibilities in solving climate change.

To start with,  governments are the sovereign rulers and they are obligated to take drastic measures to protect  their citizens against life-threatening issues such as global warming. They should strive to have net-zero emissions. For instance, the authorities should enact a law that mandates the planting of trees by persons and corporations. However, this can aid us in becoming a carbon-neutral emissions state, sadly, they are kicking the can down the road when it comes to the life of the planet. I strongly hold the view that the burden rests on them to protect mother earth instead of the human being.

Moreover, asides from the fact that our leaders are grappling with the issue of humidity, they should tackle it face down. They need to do their bits by encouraging their subjects to refrain from the excessive use of non-renewable energy such as fuel, gas, coal etc. and shall be using renewable energy like solar, wind and water.

A change in  temperature has become a new phenomenon all over the world. The above paragraphs have shown that it is the duty of the government and companies to remedy this problem.

prompt_text: Some people say that now is the best time in history to be living. What is your opinion about this? what other time in history would be interesting to live in?
essay_text:
Many people do believe in the fact that spending a life in today's world brings more happiness to them as compared to  living in the past. In my view, the early '90s would be considered  a decade when people were less digitalized but more socialized with the other people around. This essay will dictate the pointers to support the above statement.

To begin with, The fast-paced environment of the current world has impacted  people's regular lives. To elaborate, as compared to the past, individuals in present are not able to find time to spend with their dear ones because they are tending be mostly occupied with building a wealthy life to sustain in this competitive era. For instance, a report of 2019 from WHO  mentioned that  ten per cent of the population falls under the category that addressed clinical depression However, the number has  jumped, and today it has reached twenty per cent.

Additionally, Since the beginning of the 21st, century it has been observed that the impact of global warming on the earth's health has also been impacted. Moreover, natural calamities are bringing disasters and the sufferings are being faced by  human beings. However,  less consumption in the old days followed by individuals’ lesser demands kept Earth as a balanced planet to survive. For instance, an article forms a famous environmentalist from the US named Daniel Harper mentioned in his recent article that the planet's present condition would get worse in the future if we follow the current practices. However, if we can shift our focus to surviving with lesser desires in the past then we can again make the current world a better place to live.

To conclude, with all the advancements in the field of technology and science, the world has become a better place to live, but with a little care towards the earth's wellness, we all could make a living on our planet the best and kind for all the beings.

prompt_text: In the past, most people worked for small businesses, while more people now work for large businesses. What are the advantages and disadvantages of working for large businesses?
essay_text:
With the economic development, many companies have achieved impressive results. While earlier it was common to work within small firms, now people mostly have a job at huge corporations.  In this essay, I will examine what I consider to be the benefits and potential drawbacks of working in a powerful company. 

There are several advantages stemming from the fact that corporations have enormous profits. The main one is the greater income employee receives. Indeed, having a great market share enterprises tend to pay their workers much more than the average salary on the job market. That is why, doing the same, employees are paid more amount of money. In addition, such companies have a tendency to invest a lot into employee’s development. By providing them with advanced and expensive academic courses related to job duties in order to boost worker’s performance. At the same time, small businesses are really limited in these two cases as have less budgeting. 

Despite these positives, disadvantages should be considered too. Many people struggle to be promoted in such firms. Obviously, there is a lack of opportunities for promotion as the number of employees is huge and in order to get the desired position you will probably have to wait until the current person in this position will be promoted higher, that is not the case for small firms though. Moreover, you could be easily replaced by another person. Corporations do not appreciate their team as much as small companies do, and could fire even if you did a minor mistake. 

In conclusion, although there are some benefits that will allow you to live easier with a better wage and have constant development of your knowledge, the risk of staying a long time at one vacancy or being dismissed is high.
